```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Shared settings for all pages: the nine cities and their fixed colours
// (a city keeps the same colour in every chart).
cities = ["Milan", "Turin", "Genoa", "Bologna", "Verona", "Padua", "Monza-Brianza", "Bergamo", "Brescia"]
colourOf = ({
  "Milan": "#2a78d6", "Milan area": "#2a78d6", "Turin": "#eb6834", "Genoa": "#1baf7a",
  "Bologna": "#eda100", "Verona": "#e87ba4", "Padua": "#008300",
  "Monza-Brianza": "#4a3aa7", "Bergamo": "#e34948", "Brescia": "#898781",
  "Northern Italy": "#898781", "Italy": "#898781"
})
colourFor = (list) => ({domain: list, range: list.map(c => colourOf[c])})
pct = v => d3.format("+.1f")(Math.abs(v) < 0.05 ? 0 : v)  // no "−0.0"
```
